_description: Block `git commit` if any [AGENT: X] or /namespace:verb reference in agents/, commands/, or CLAUDE.md is broken. Silent no-op outside stack-agents-style repos.
_notes: When installed at user scope, $CLAUDE_HOOK_DIR resolves to $HOME/.claude/hooks. The lint-references-on-commit.sh script auto-detects the linter location (env STACK_AGENTS_LINTER, then ~/.claude/scripts/, then ./scripts/).
When installed at project scope, the hook command path becomes bash .claude/hooks/lint-references-on-commit.sh and the linter is found at .claude/scripts/lint-references.mjs.
The linter exits 0 (no-op) in any repo that lacks both agents/ and commands/ — safe for projects that aren't orchestration repos.
